I got tired of handing my traffic to an analytics company just to learn that four people read my site yesterday. 📊

So I built the opposite: a dashboard that never leaves my own network. nginx logs in, App Store sales in, one page on my home screen out. No account, no tracker, no cloud.

It knows nothing about me — everything comes from a config.json. So it's yours too, MIT, read it before you run it:

https://patrickostertag.ch/dashboard.html

#SelfHosted #IndieDev #Privacy #Tailscale #Python #iOSDev
